meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: Explore-first planning consultant that writes one decision-complete work plan before coding. Use only on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow or a plan before implementation; it never self-activates on a bare ulw run.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把模糊需求梳理成一份可直接照做的开发计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果接到任务后想先理清步骤和取舍再动手写代码
copy.tagline_en: Turn a vague request into a decision-complete plan before you start coding
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to settle steps and tradeoffs before writing code

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会以「规划顾问」身份工作:先做只读探索,产出唯一的、决策完备的工作计划文件,期间不碰产品代码、不做实现。计划写入批准后才会写,执行由你另起会话启动。
howto.when: 仅在你明确提出 ulw-plan 工作流,或要求在写代码前先出一份计划时触发;单独的 ulw 运行不会自动启用它。

say.text: 用 ulw-plan 帮我规划这个需求,先别写代码
say.note: 它会先并行探索,再给出计划供你确认

say.text: 开 ulw-plan,这份计划要高强度审查
ulw-plan:先问我几个关键问题再定计划
say.note: 它会只就探索无法定夺的分叉向你提问

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude works as a planning consultant: it does read-only exploration first, then writes one decision-complete work plan file under .omo/, without editing product code or implementing. The plan is written only after you approve.
howto.when_en: Triggers only when you explicitly ask for the ulw-plan workflow, or for a plan before implementation. A bare ulw run never self-activates it.

say_en.text: Use ulw-plan to plan this request; don't write code yet
say_en.note: It explores first, then hands you a plan to approve

say_en.text: Run ulw-plan with high-accuracy review on this plan
say_en.note: Marks review required, then runs plan-reviewer after approval

say_en.text: ulw-plan: ask me the key questions before planning
say_en.note: It asks only the forks exploration can't settle
